title: MUC-FL: Block-Wise Marginal Utility Contribution for Communication-Efficient Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.10545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed model training without centralizing data but suffers from high communication overhead. To address this, we propose Block-Wise Marginal Utility Contribution (MUC), a framework that selectively transmits only the most impactful data blocks based on their contribution to model performance. To evaluate our framework, we apply it to a multimodal dataset integrated from multiple MIMIC clinical datasets and show that only 24 out of 1,135 candidate blocks (1.76%) carry meaningful improvement signals, enabling a potential communication reduction of 45-50% while maintaining or improving model quality. Our deduplication-based block selection achieves a macro F1 score of 0.8566 compared to 0.8155 for standard federated optimization, demonstrating that selective transmission can improve performance, particularly in underrepresented classes.

translated_title: MUC-FL：用于通信高效联邦学习的分块边际效用贡献
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使分布式模型训练无需集中数据，但存在高通信开销的问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了分块边际效用贡献（MUC），这是一个基于数据块对模型性能的贡献，仅选择性传输最具影响力数据块的框架。为评估我们的框架，我们将其应用于由多个MIMIC临床数据集整合而成的多模态数据集，结果显示1135个候选块中仅有24个（1.76%）携带有效的改进信号，这有望实现45-50%的通信量减少，同时保持或提高模型质量。我们基于去重的块选择方法实现了0.8566的宏F1分数，而标准联邦优化仅为0.8155，这表明选择性传输可以提升性能，尤其是在代表性不足的类别上。
tldr: 提出MUC-FL框架，通过分块边际效用贡献仅选择性传输最有价值的数据块，在将联邦学习通信量减少45-50%的同时提升模型性能（宏F1分数从0.8155提升至0.8566）。
en_tdlr: MUC-FL selectively transmits only the most impactful data blocks based on marginal utility contribution, reducing federated learning communication by 45-50% while improving model performance (macro F1 from 0.8155 to 0.8566).
